day_shape: US State Department launches 'Operation Economic Outcast' sanctioning 36 aviation-sector entities including 27 Iranian airlines, UK FCDO lays new Iran sanctions legislation, IRGC claims capture of US unmanned submarine and downing of MQ-1 drone in Strait of Hormuz, Houthi strikes wound 73 in southern Saudi Arabia.

threads.label: US and UK aviation and nuclear sanctions
threads.summary: The US State Department announced Operation Economic Outcast, sanctioning 36 entities and individuals across multiple jurisdictions for supporting Iran's aviation sector, including 27 Iranian airlines linked to Mahan Air. The UK FCDO laid legislation expanding Iran sanctions on energy, metals, banking, insurance and shipping, with amendments effective 29 September 2026.

threads.label: IRGC Strait of Hormuz claims
threads.summary: IRGC channels claimed the capture of a US unmanned underwater vessel and the interception of an MQ-1 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, issued via Defa Press and IRIB. The Jerusalem Post reported shipping through the strait slowed after Iranian threats of retaliation for any new US attacks.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on southern Saudi Arabia
threads.summary: Iran International reported Houthi attacks on energy facilities and cities in southern Saudi Arabia wounded at least 73 people, with Defa Press citing warning alarms in Jizan and reported explosions near Abha and Najran. Ansarallah political bureau members told Al-Mayadeen and Al-Ahd that a 'crushing' response to Saudi strikes was on the way.

threads.label: October 7 pre-warning reports
threads.summary: Multiple Israeli press reports said UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed personally warned Netanyahu days before Hamas's 7 October 2023 attack that a major offensive was being planned, with Naftali Bennett confirming the Haaretz account. Separate reporting said Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar warned Netanyahu less than a week beforehand that Hamas was 'preparing something extreme'.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressure and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International reported security forces deployed around fuel stations as a gasoline price rise took effect, a new compulsory university hijab directive is being prepared, and the judiciary confirmed detention of hardline cleric Mohammad-Bagher Kharrazi. The Jerusalem Post reported former president Hassan Rouhani's call for public input on ending the war prompted hardliner demands for his arrest.

threads.label: Iran nuclear and IAEA posture
threads.summary: Iran's delegation to the IAEA Board of Governors said the Agency bears responsibility over the attack on Iran's nuclear facilities and questioned the meaning of nuclear security absent action against 'illegal attacks', according to Defa Press. Canada's Federal Court ordered a visa decision within 60 days for a former Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant project manager held in security screening over 900 days.

threads.label: Israeli operations and maritime posture
threads.summary: Israel's Navy chief Vice Adm. Eyal Harel said Israel would not allow threats to its freedom of action at sea, in remarks reported as aimed at Turkey and the Houthis. The IDF said it struck a Gaza City operative and Hamas infrastructure in Khan Younis, and eliminated an attacker near Aqraba after a Molotov and knife assault.

events.title_en: Death toll in Gaza Strip reaches 73,662. Palestinian Health Ministry in Gaza announced that in the past 24 hours...
events.summary_en: Death toll in Gaza Strip reaches 73,662. Palestinian Health Ministry in Gaza announced that in the past 24 hours, the bodies of 4 martyrs and 5 wounded have been transferred to hospitals in Gaza Strip. The ministry also announced that since the ceasefire came into effect on 11 October, 1,355 people have been killed, 4,516 have been wounded and the bodies of 827 martyrs have been recovered from under rubble or various areas. According to the Gaza Health Ministry announcement, following the continuation of Zionist regime violations against Gaza Strip, the total number of martyrs in this war has reached 73,662 people and the number of wounded has reached 174,627 people.

events.title: The Israeli Air Force targeted a terror operative in Gaza City and struck Hamas infrastructure sites in the Strip's south a short while ago, according to the military. Palestinian media reports that the strike in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood wounded several people. The strikes in southern Gaza's Khan Younis also wounded several Palestinians, according to the reports. The IDF says it will provide further details on the strikes later.

events.title: Canadian court orders visa decision for former Bushehr nuclear plant manager
events.summary: Canada’s Federal Court has ordered the government to decide within 60 days on a visitor visa application from a former project manager at Iran’s Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant after the case remained in security screening for more than 900 days.

events.title: 🔴 ELIMINATED: A terrorist who attempted to carry out an attack against IDF soldiers in the area of Aqraba. The terrorist hurled a Molotov cocktail and an explosive device at the soldiers before attempting to attack them with a knife. The soldiers eliminated him. No IDF injuries were reported. Four additional terrorists were apprehended, including weapons traffickers and a terrorist planning an imminent attack. Troops also located weapons and military equipment.

events.title: Iranian protester undergoes months of secret treatment to save wounded leg
events.summary: A 34-year-old protester shot in the Iranian city of Qazvin on January 8 has undergone five major operations and months of largely secret medical care as doctors work to save and reconstruct his badly damaged leg.
